messages:
Asha (PM): Quick sync — planning q2 roadmap slices for Hosted API. We need a compact ship-criteria doc that ties OKRs to measurable signals. Can we sketch required gates for chat/completions/embeddings/rerank?
Ben (Eng): +1. Propose we use three bucketed acceptance signals per surface: correctness (eval pass rate), perf (p50/p95), and unit-cost (tokens/second or $/k tokens).
Marta (SRE): Also require operational gates: max error rate under 99th pct concurrency, and an agreed rollback window for canaries. If a canary breaches p95 latency by >2x for 5m, auto-fallback.
Priya (Solutions): Customers keep asking for predictable embedding latency for search use cases. Suggest a dedicated SLA target of median embed <120ms for up to 1000 qps per-customer after dedicated mode.
Liam (Design): We should document the developer experience acceptance too — clear error messages and non-blocking streaming UX for chat. UX criteria: streaming-enabled by default and fallback message that indicates partial result.
Eve (Data): For quality signals, we can tie to the eval harness: require no new regressions on the core prompt set (>95% pass on rubric), and per-customer sample checks for top 5 customers. I'll own dashboards.
Asha (PM): OK let me propose concrete gates per surface and we iterate: 1) Chat/completions: eval pass >=95%, p50 <=120ms, p95 <=350ms, cost delta <= +10% vs baseline. 2) Embeddings: embedding correctness (cosine recall >=92% on benchmark), median latency <=120ms, throughput stable at 2x baseline for burst. 3) Rerank: rerank accuracy uplift >=3% on benchmark, end-to-end p95 <=450ms, support streaming partial scores.
Ben (Eng): Implementation notes: we'll expose a `compat` flag to enable experimental quantized kernels. We should include a rollout plan: single-region canary -> controlled traffic cohorts -> multi-region ramp. Code snippet for canary config: ```
canary:
  percent: 5
  duration: 30m
  rollback_criteria:
    p95_latency: 2x
    error_rate: 1.5x
```
Marta (SRE): Add circuit-breaker for background queues and KV cache miss storms. Also require chaos test: brief network partition during canary, ensure fallback works.
Priya (Solutions): Customer handoff checklist: doc with per-customer expected cost impact, migration steps, and sample prompts. Must include a small script to replay customer prompt sets against new model variant.
Asha (PM): Launch readiness checklist draft (must-haves): - Acceptance metrics hit for all three signals - Canary run for min 48h with no critical alerts - Docs + migration guide + cost impact estimate - 2 customer pilot signoffs (for embeddings and rerank) - SDKs updated and smoke-tested
Liam (Design): For SDK smoke tests, include a UI example of streaming chunked responses and a graceful error card for model fallback. I'll attach a sketch after this thread.
Eve (Data): We'll track three dashboards: Quality regressions, Cost per token trend, and Per-customer latency SLA. Alert thresholds: quality drop >2% or cost spike >15% sustained 30m.
Ben (Eng): Dependency map: runtime quantization work (eng-runtime), batching improvements (eng-platform), metrics hooks (eng-infra), and console dashboard surfaces (product + eng-obs). Estimate: 6w eng runtime + 3w infra + 2w obs. Any objections?
Marta (SRE): Ops requirement: docs for emergency fallback to smaller model pool, and a runbook for cross-region failover. Need pager coverage training.
Asha (PM): No major objections. Next steps: Ben to draft an implementable rollout plan + ETA, Eve to produce initial dashboards, Priya to collect two pilot customers, Liam to produce UX mocks. We'll reconvene in 48h with concrete timelines.
Ben (Eng): I'll post the rollout outline by EOD tomorrow.
Priya (Solutions): I'll ping two customers now — @Acme & @Nimbus (internal short names) — and ask for pilot window.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment for branch hosted/q2-roadmap started (5% traffic).
Marta (SRE): Noted — monitoring hooks live. I'll run a simulated partition in the canary window and report back.
Asha (PM): Great — thanks everyone. If you have additions to the ship-criteria list, drop them here. Will synthesize into a short PRD and attach the acceptance checklist. :raised_hands:
